name: Corrupt video rejection offers a retry path

planSteps.description: Choose a small corrupt file named invalid.mp4 and submit it.
Verify the response explains that the video is unreadable and gives export/retry guidance.
Verify a Retry upload action is available and no preview or analysis result is shown.
Replace the corrupt selection with a valid small MP4 and submit it.
Verify the replacement upload reaches Preview ready and still states that analysis has not started.
